Hi Alicia —

On Thu, 24 Aug 2028 at 09:12, Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@lumenix-instruments.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for taking the call earlier. Per our procurement checklist, attaching our Articles of Incorporation and a contact sheet. We'd like to start receiving POs from Redwood next quarter; what do you need from us to get set up in your vendor system?

Thanks for the docs — this is a good start. To complete the vendor master profile and enable PO issuance we need the following items from Lumenix: 

1) Notarized entity affirmation or signed affidavit confirming the legal name and jurisdiction (we require notarized confirmation for all new corporate vendors over $100k ARR).
2) Completed Redwood vendor intake template (I've attached a blank copy for your convenience).
3) W-9 (US entities) or the appropriate W-8 form if non-US tax status applies.
4) Primary AP contact (name, email, phone) and preferred invoice routing (email / E-invoice / portal).
5) Bank details for ACH setup — we'll route a secure link from our payments team once the account is created.

Please attach the notarized affidavit and W-9 where possible. If notarization will take time, we can provisionally create a non-payable vendor record to accept quotes and test POs, but we won't be able to schedule payments until paperwork is complete.

Jordan — can you confirm the expected internal lead time for PO creation once we have a notarized affidavit + W-9?

Kimberly — once NA vendor paperwork is received, can you start the ERP provisioning (vendor code + remit instructions)?

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Procurement Program Manager
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodai.com
+1 415-555-0198

Alicia —

Received the notarized affidavit and W-9, thank you — that completes the legal/tax packet. I've forwarded the intake sheet to AP for vendor code creation. Next steps: 

- Kimberly: please create vendor code and remit instructions in ERP; note "ACH pending verification" until payments team completes bank validation.
- Jordan: once vendor code is live, please create a test non-payable PO (PO-TEST-Lum-001) so Lumenix can verify invoice reception.
- Alicia: I'll send a DocuSign for our standard supplier terms (purely for records) and a secure link for bank account submission for payments team. DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/templates/abcd-entity-affirmation

We aim to have the vendor active for PO issuance within 3 business days from now, contingent on ERP provisioning and bank validation. If you need POs sooner for quoting, we can issue an internal test PO earlier.

Thanks again — welcome to Redwood.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
